value.zh: 使用 dns 模式和子域字典查询候选主机名，保存解析值并过滤通配 DNS，结果还需进行所有权确认。
value.en: Use dns mode and a subdomain wordlist to query candidate hostnames, preserving answers and filtering wildcard DNS before ownership confirmation.

value.zh: 用 SecLists raft-medium 词表做目录枚举，按技术栈追加扩展名并限并发 50；词表清单只是资源，真正下发的是这条 dir 命令。
value.en: Run directory enumeration against the SecLists raft-medium wordlist, appending stack-appropriate extensions with 50 threads; the wordlist paths are just resources, this dir command is what actually runs.

value.zh: 主动枚举并暴力解析候选子域；v4 起不再有 -brute 开关，配合 -active 与词表 -w 即启用暴破解析。
value.en: Active enumeration with brute resolution; amass v4 removed -brute, pairing -active with a -w wordlist enables brute forcing.

value.zh: 反向 WHOIS 与组织名关联发现；v4 移除了 -max-dns-queries 限速开关，翻找范围由组织名与域名控制。
value.en: Reverse WHOIS and organization-based discovery; v4 removed -max-dns-queries, scope is controlled by the org and domain flags.

value.zh: 查看枚举会话与资产关系图；v4 移除了 viz 子命令，会话列表用 db -list，关系图用 graph。
value.en: Inspect enumeration sessions and the asset graph; v4 removed viz, use db -list for sessions and graph for visualization.

value.zh: 加载自建模板对单目标校验；模板 YAML 写在本地文件（id/info/requests 结构见 nuclei 官方模板规范），用 -t 引用而不是把 YAML 当命令粘贴。
value.en: Validate one target with a local custom template; author the YAML (id/info/requests per the nuclei template spec) in a file and reference it with -t instead of pasting YAML as a command.

import requests
import time
{TARGET} = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/password-reset"
tokens = []
for index in range(5):
    response = requests.post({TARGET}, json={"account": f"payloader-{index}"}, timeout=5)
    response.raise_for_status()
    token = response.json()["test_token"]
    tokens.append(token)
    print(index, len(token), token[:6])
    time.sleep(1)
print("unique", len(set(tokens)) == len(tokens))
# Analyze length and uniqueness only; do not claim predictability without a validated generator model.
